title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Resolute

This fix excludes the bundled FIPS 140 snapshot ZIPs from dh_strip_nondeterminism to preserve the certified upstream checksums. This aligns the golang-1.25 package in Resolute with the fix already merged for golang-1.27.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448

PPA Build: https://launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/+archive/ubuntu/fips-fix/+packages?field.name_filter=golang-1.25&field.status_filter=published&field.series_filter=resolute
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174696
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ead609e..8078e58 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+golang-1.25 (1.25.14-1~ubuntu0.26.04.2) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Exclude native fips140 module zips from dh_strip_nondeterminism 
+    to preserve upstream checksums and fix Go 1.25 validation (LP: #2174696).
+
+ -- Sumit Tiwari <sumit.tiwari@canonical.com>  Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:54:46 +0530
+
 golang-1.25 (1.25.14-1~ubuntu0.26.04.1) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Backport golang-1.25 1.25.14-1 to resolute (LP: #2166409).
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 8a35717..be1d2c9 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -91,7 +91,8 @@ override_dh_strip:
 override_dh_dwz:
 
 override_dh_strip_nondeterminism:
-	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata
+	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata \
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140
 
 override_dh_shlibdeps:
 	dh_shlibdeps -Xtestdata -Xtest
